lines.text: Innumeros dedit infuper hîc & ubiq; Prophetas
lines.en: He gave innumerable Prophets, moreover, here and everywhere,

lines.text: Qui uerum nobis concionentur iter
lines.en: Who might preach the true path to us

lines.text: Sic rutilis uires arcanas indidit aftris:
lines.en: Thus he imparted secret powers to the glowing stars:

lines.text: Quæ pręsaga, hominum fata notare folent.
lines.en: Which, prophetic, are accustomed to mark the fates of men.

lines.text: Vt fi fint nobis bona fata ostenfa, parentis
lines.en: So that if good fates are shown to us, we might confess

lines.text: Æterni largas confiteamur opes:
lines.en: The abundant wealth of the Eternal parent:

lines.text: Sin mala, furgentem tumidas, flectamus, in iras
lines.en: But if bad, we might bend the rising, swelling angers,

lines.text: Vt faltem ostenfas mitiget ille minas
lines.en: So that he might at least mitigate the shown threats

lines.text: Vana fuperftitio ftudio procul abfit ab ifto,
lines.en: Let vain superstition be far absent from that study,

lines.text: Namq; Dei uetita eft legibus illa facris:
lines.en: for it is forbidden by the sacred laws of God:

lines.text: Natura duce quæ fiunt hæc fola fequamur,
lines.en: Let us follow only these things which happen with nature as guide,

lines.text: Quæ contra: ut ftygias defugiamus aquas.
lines.en: Those which are contrary: let us flee them like Stygian waters.

lines.text: Hoc cum fine colas dominam Ioachime Mathefin,
lines.en: With this end may you cultivate the mistress Mathesis, Joachim,

lines.text: Imprimis labor eft utilis ille tuus,
lines.en: Especially that labor of yours is useful,

lines.text: Quo ueterũ illuftras monumenta antiqua uirorum,
lines.en: By which you illuminate the ancient monuments of old men,

lines.text: Queîs erat in fuperas fcandere cura domos:
lines.en: Whose care was to climb into the upper houses:

lines.text: Macte igitur pietate iftac: numeraberis inter
lines.en: Well done therefore with that piety: you will be numbered among

lines.text: Fœlices animas fic Ioachime, uale.
lines.en: The happy souls thus, Joachim, farewell.

summary.headline: Messahala Chapter List Begins
summary.text: Dedication poem to Joachim praises astrology as a natural study of the stars’ indications of human fates and rejects superstition. The chapter list of Messahala’s book begins with luminaries from the ascendant, triplicities, division of the earth, and revolutions of the world’s years.
